extracted.name: Cabbage & chilli slaw
extracted.description: Serve this cabbage and chilli slaw with doner kebabs. Chill for a day or two, and it will soften and transform into a lighter, kimchi-style slaw
ingredient_lines: ½ quantity smoky chilli sauce (see recipe in 'Goes well with', below)
8 spring onions trimmed and finely sliced on an angle
instruction_lines: Toss the cabbage in a bowl with ½ tsp salt. Set aside for 30 mins, then rinse under cold running water. Leave to dry in a colander.
Return the cabbage to the bowl and toss with the chilli sauce, lemon juice and spring onions. Will keep in the fridge for up to two days.
